dispute.claim_text: I bought a professional certification course advertised as government-accredited. It is not accredited by anyone. I was misled about what I was buying.

evidence.text: Course sales page: 'Government-accredited certification, officially recognized.'
Reply from the named accrediting authority: 'We have no record of this provider or course; it is not accredited by us.'

labels.notes: Clear misrepresentation. The sales page represented the course as government-accredited (ev_001); the named authority confirms it is not (ev_003). This is a misrepresentation of what was sold (accreditation status), not a quality complaint, so 13.5-r2 is consumer-supported.
